context.situation: Dashboard lost styling/navigation; n8n seemed broken; local ports conflicted.
root_causes: Conflicting local dev servers on ports 3001/3002
Recent edits diverged from stable baseline
Git HEAD corruption masked repo state

learnings: Before debugging UI, ensure only one dev server is running
When instability occurs, revert to last known-good commit and verify
Prefer npm over yarn in this repo to avoid GITHUB_TOKEN env issues
next_steps: Add port preflight to dev script
